models.M0: constant psi and daily p (2 free parameters)
models.M1: constant psi and logistic p_j=logit^-1(alpha+beta*(j-10.5)/10.5) (3 parameters); j is 0-based observation column, NOT calendar date
models.M2: constant psi and separate logistic early (days 1-11) vs late (days 12-22) detection p (3 parameters)

likelihood: site-level mixture of never-occupied and occupied Bernoulli detection histories, NA occasions omitted; no false positives
selection: compare AIC and AICc (N=87 sites); do not use nested LR p-values as proof of causal time effect
robustness: all 22 days and 7/14-day constant-p reference retained; report per-day p and psi shifts; no simulated detection covariates
source_integrity: fail if source SHA differs or full constant p and psi differ from previous result by >2e-5
interpretation: Detection heterogeneity is indexed by column order, not verified dates; temporal closure and effort remain unverified. No full A/B/M field inference, no fourth EOG-WF endpoint.
